method: Android API 36 emulator, Expo Go dev bundle :8082, 1080x2400 / 420dpi, 8-second running timer stationary capture; same QA polling bridge. Before: animated procedural rain. After: static generated scene plus ticking clock. One sample each, not a release/device latency or battery benchmark.
